reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 66. Lower bound is an independent set of size 66 (check passed; matches cpsat_alpha's proven 66). Upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_7 of length 66; code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed, so the bracket [66,66] is closed. Versus baselines: agent beats cpsat_cover (78, unproven, 120.5 s), frac_cover (71.5, 76.5 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 65), which do not reach 66. kushagra_agent also proved 66 with F_7 in 0.041 s; the agent's compute was similar (0.052 s) but wall time was 29.469 s, almost all LLM time (29.417 s), so it is far slower end to end. Nothing suspicious; hypothesis params were left empty though only one code was needed.
